data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate released $149.6m of prior year claims reserves in 2014 (2013: $215.7m), driven by favourable claims development and exceptional releases in 2013 principally in the reinsurance and political risks & contingency areas. The reserve releases in 2014 were distributed across Marine, Political risks & contingency, Property, Reinsurance and Specialty lines. There was minimal exposure to natural catastrophes during the year, with a small exposure to Hurricane Odile noted on the property and reinsurance books.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 we were able to release prior year reserves of $149.6m (2013: $215.7m).
The reduction in reserve releases in 2014 compared to 2013 was driven by the exceptional releases seen in 2013 in the reinsurance and political risks and contingency divisions.
There has been minimal exposure to natural catastrophes throughout the year, with a small exposure to Hurricane Odile seen on the property and reinsurance books.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are taken from the 2014 annual report presented in US dollars (syndicate's functional currency). Opening reserves taken from the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (2013). Prior year development taken from the Managing Agent's narrative which explicitly states gross 'release prior year reserves of $149.6m' and is supported by the breakdown table by division. Line-of-business mapping for 'Political risks & contingency' and 'Specialty lines' to standard Lloyd's names is approximate.
